snippet.title: Fruitbus | PS5 Release Date | Announcement
snippet.description:
🍊 Wishlist now on PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gr/concept/10014364

The cozy, feel-good food truck adventure is coming to PlayStation 5 - and it’s almost time to hit the road! Build your kitchen-on-wheels, forage for fresh ingredients, cook delicious meals, and serve joy to a cast of charming characters in a beautiful world.

Explore at your own pace. Make new friends. Feed the world, one fruit at a time.

Coming 19th June 2025

#fruitbus #cozygaming #indiegame
